newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest cuts Glaxo margins. [CORRECTED 10:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest cuts Glaxo margins. [CORRECTED 10:05 GMT]

text.p: NatWest cut its estimates for operating margins at Glaxo Wellcome Plc on Monday while retaining an "add" rating on the drug stock, market sources said.

For 1997, NatWest cut its margin estimate to 35.5 percent from 37.5 percent in 1996, sources said. (Corrects to clarify that previous estimate was for 1996.) Analysts at the brokerage declined comment.
Last week analysts at BZW turned neutral on the short-term outlook for Glaxo shares, warning that profit margins may come under pressure this year due to the cost of launching new drugs.
Glaxo shares were up five pence at 12.44 stg by 0835 GMT.
